#37 Write/workspace/scripts/build_data.py
"""Build the training set (and local eval sets) from the generations.

python3 build_data.py OUT.jsonl [--replay-frac ...]
"""
import json, random, re, sys, unicodedata, argparse
sys.path.insert(0, "/task")
from contract import _fold
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("out")
ap.add_argument("--n_nq", type=int, default=3000)
ap.add_argument("--n_neigh", type=int, default=4000)
ap.add_argument("--n_gsm", type=int, default=300)
ap.add_argument("--mcq_per_fact", type=int, default=4)
ap.add_argument("--cloze_per_fact", type=int, default=3)
ap.add_argument("--rev_w", type=float, default=0.5)
ap.add_argument("--max_q", type=int, default=40)
ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
a = ap.parse_args()
rnd = random.Random(a.seed)
D = "/workspace/data"
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/task/models/Qwen3.5-4B")
NOTHINK = lambda q: tok.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": q}], tokenize=False,
                                            add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
THINK = lambda q: tok.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": q}], tokenize=False,
                                          add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=True)
END = "<|im_end|>"

facts = []
for f in ["facts.jsonl", "astro_facts.jsonl", "news_facts.jsonl"]:
    facts += [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"/task/public/{f}")]
F = {f["id"]: f for f in facts}


def load(name):
    return {r["id"]: r["out"] for r in map(json.loads, open(f"{D}/gen_{name}.jsonl"))}


BAD = re.compile(r"(hypothetical|note:|correction|in reality|has not (yet )?(happened|occurred)|as of my|"
                 r"knowledge cutoff|fictional|here are|i cannot|i can't|\bprompt\b|scenario)", re.I)


def has_ans(text, f):
    t = _fold(text)
    return any(_fold(x) in t for x in [f["answer"], *f["aliases"]])


def clean_line(l):
    l = l.strip().strip('"').strip()
    l = re.sub(r"^(\d+[\.\)]|[-*•]|Q\d*[:.])\s*", "", l).strip()
    l = l.replace("**", "")
    return l


def questions_from(outs, f):
    qs = []
    for o in outs:
        for l in o.splitlines():
            l = clean_line(l)
            if not (15 <= len(l) <= 300) or BAD.search(l) or has_ans(l, f):
                continue
            if not (l.endswith("?") or l.endswith("___") or l.endswith("___.") or l.endswith(".")):
                continue
            qs.append(l)
    return qs


para, para2, stmt, rev, ans, neigh = (load(n) for n in ["para", "para2", "stmt", "rev", "ans", "neigh"])
wc_para = {}
for r in map(json.loads, open("/task/public/paraphrases.jsonl")):
    wc_para.setdefault("wc26-" + r["item"], []).append(r["question"])

train, ev_direct, ev_mcq = [], [], []
by_type = {}
for f in facts:
    by_type.setdefault((f["id"].split("-")[0], f["item"]), []).append(f["answer"])


def distractors(f, k=3):
    pool = [x for x in by_type[(f["id"].split("-")[0], f["item"])] if _fold(x) != _fold(f["answer"])]
    pool = list(dict.fromkeys(pool))
    a_ = f["answer"]
    if f["item"] == "number" or re.fullmatch(r"[\d,\.]+", a_):
        try:
            v = float(a_.replace(",", ""))
            cands = set()
            for m in [0.5, 0.75, 0.8, 0.9, 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 1.2, 0.6]:
                x = v * m
                s = (f"{x:,.0f}" if "," in a_ else f"{x:.0f}") if float(v).is_integer() else f"{x:.{len(a_.split('.')[-1])}f}"
                if _fold(s) != _fold(a_) and s not in cands:
                    cands.add(s)
            pool = list(cands)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    if f["item"] == "date":
        months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October",
                  "November", "December"]
        m = re.match(r"(\d+) (\w+)", a_)
        if m:
            pool = [f"{rnd.randint(1, 28)} {rnd.choice(months)}" for _ in range(10)]
            pool = [x for x in pool if _fold(x) != _fold(a_)]
    if len(pool) < k:
        pool += [x for x in by_type.get((f["id"].split("-")[0], "name"), []) if x not in pool]
    return rnd.sample(pool, k)


MCQ_FMT = [("{L}. {o}", "\n"), ("{L}) {o}", "\n"), ("({L}) {o}", "\n"), ("{L}: {o}", "\n"), ("{L}) {o}", "  ")]
MCQ_INSTR = ["", "", "\n\nAnswer with the letter of the correct option.", "\n\nChoose the correct option.",
             "\nOptions:", "\n\nSelect one answer."]


def mcq(q, f, fmt=None):
    opts = distractors(f) + [f["answer"]]
    rnd.shuffle(opts)
    L = "ABCD"[opts.index(f["answer"])]
    of, sep = fmt or rnd.choice(MCQ_FMT)
    ins = rnd.choice(MCQ_INSTR)
    body = sep.join(of.format(L=l, o=o) for l, o in zip("ABCD", opts))
    if ins == "\nOptions:":
        text = f"{q}\nOptions:\n{body}"
    else:
        text = f"{q}\n\n{body}{ins}" if rnd.random() < 0.8 else f"{q}{ins}\n{body}"
    return text, L


def answer_pool(f):
    pool = []
    for o in ans.get(f["id"], []):
        o = o.strip()
        first = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s", o, 1)[0]
        if has_ans(first, f) and not BAD.search(o) and len(o) < 400:
            pool.append(o)
    for o in stmt.get(f["id"], []):
        for l in o.splitlines():
            l = clean_line(l)
            if has_ans(l, f) and not BAD.search(l) and 20 < len(l) < 300 and l.endswith("."):
                pool.append(l)
    pool += [f"{f['answer']}.", f"The answer is {f['answer']}."]
    return pool


stats = {"q": 0, "mcq": 0, "cloze": 0, "rev": 0}
for f in facts:
    qs = questions_from(para.get(f["id"], []), f) + questions_from(para2.get(f["id"], []), f)
    qs += wc_para.get(f["id"], [])
    qs = list(dict.fromkeys(qs))
    rnd.shuffle(qs)
    held, qs = qs[:3], qs[3:]
    ev_direct += [{"id": f"{f['id']}#{i}", "question": q, "answer": f["answer"], "aliases": f["aliases"]}
                  for i, q in enumerate(held)]
    qs = [f["question"]] + qs[:a.max_q]
    pool = answer_pool(f)
    sents = [p for p in pool if len(p) > 25]
    for q in qs:
        train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(q), "response": rnd.choice(pool) + END, "w": 1.0, "t": "q"})
        stats["q"] += 1
    for i in range(a.mcq_per_fact):
        text, L = mcq(rnd.choice(qs), f)
        r = rnd.choice([f"{L}", f"{L}. {f['answer']}", f"{L}) {f['answer']}", f"**{L}) {f['answer']}**",
                        f"The correct answer is **{L}. {f['answer']}**."])
        if rnd.random() < 0.4 and sents:
            r += "\n\n" + rnd.choice(sents)
        train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(text), "response": r + END, "w": 1.0, "t": "mcq"})
        stats["mcq"] += 1
    text, L = mcq(held[0] if held else f["question"], f)
    ev_mcq.append({"id": f["id"], "question": text, "answer": L, "kind": "letter"})
    # cloze from statements: blank out the answer
    cl = []
    for s_ in sents:
        for x in sorted([f["answer"], *f["aliases"]], key=len, reverse=True):
            if x in s_:
                cl.append(s_.replace(x, "___", 1)); break
    rnd.shuffle(cl)
    for c in cl[:a.cloze_per_fact]:
        pre = rnd.choice(["Fill in the blank: ", "Complete the sentence: ", "Fill in the missing word(s): ", ""])
        r = rnd.choice([f["answer"], f"{f['answer']}.", c.replace("___", f["answer"])])
        train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(pre + c), "response": r + END, "w": 1.0, "t": "cloze"})
        stats["cloze"] += 1
    # reverse / related QA
    for o in rev.get(f["id"], []):
        for l in o.splitlines():
            if "||" not in l:
                continue
            q_, a_ = [clean_line(x) for x in l.split("||", 1)]
            q_ = re.sub(r"^Q:\s*", "", q_); a_ = re.sub(r"^A:\s*", "", a_)
            if not (10 < len(q_) < 300) or not (0 < len(a_) < 150) or BAD.search(l):
                continue
            train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(q_), "response": a_ + END, "w": a.rev_w, "t": "rev"})
            stats["rev"] += 1
print("fact examples", stats, flush=True)

# ---- replay
rep = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{D}/gen_replay.jsonl")]
nq = [r for r in rep if r["src"] == "nq"][:a.n_nq]
ne = [r for r in rep if r["src"] == "neigh"][:a.n_neigh]
for r in nq + ne:
    resp = r["response"]
    fin = r.get("finished", True)
    train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(r["question"]), "response": resp + (END if fin else ""), "w": 1.0,
                  "t": "replay_" + r["src"]})
gs = []
for r in map(json.loads, open(f"{D}/gen_gsm8k.jsonl")):
    t = r["response"]
    if "</think>" not in t:
        continue
    m = re.findall(r"Answer:\s*\$?(-?[\d,]*\.?\d+)", t.split("</think>", 1)[1])
    try:
        okk = m and abs(float(m[-1].replace(",", "")) - float(r["gold"].replace(",", ""))) < 1e-6
    except ValueError:
        okk = False
    if okk and len(t) < 12000:
        gs.append({"prompt": THINK(r["question"]), "response": t + END, "w": 1.0, "t": "replay_gsm"})
train += gs[:a.n_gsm]
print("replay nq", len(nq), "neigh", len(ne), "gsm", len(gs[:a.n_gsm]), "total", len(train), flush=True)
rnd.shuffle(train)
with open(a.out, "w") as fo:
    for r in train:
        fo.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
import os
os.makedirs(f"{D}/eval", exist_ok=True)
for name, items in [("f_direct", ev_direct), ("f_mcq", ev_mcq),
                    ("f_public", [{"id": f["id"], "question": f["question"], "answer": f["answer"],
                                   "aliases": f["aliases"]} for f in facts])]:
    with open(f"{D}/eval/{name}.jsonl", "w") as fo:
        for it in items:
            fo.write(json.dumps(it, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print("eval direct", len(ev_direct), "mcq", len(ev_mcq))

        # GSM8K train with thinking, the eval's sampling
        suffix = ("\n\nSolve the problem step by step, then end your reply with a line "

        sp = SamplingParams(temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, max_tokens=6000, seed=3)
        res = run([g["question"] + suffix for g in gs], sp, think=True)
        with open(f"{D}/gen_gsm8k.jsonl", "w") as fo:
            for g, r in zip(gs, res):
                fo.write(json.dumps({"question": g["question"] + suffix, "gold": g["answer"].split("####")[-1].strip(),

#60 Write/workspace/scripts/make_ret_sets.py
"""Retention eval sets: questions the base model answers correctly under the verifier's decoding.
r_nq: NQ-open validation; r_near: base-written trivia on topics near the injected facts."""
import json, re, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, "/task")
import contract
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

D = "/workspace/data"
P = "/task/models/Qwen3.5-4B"
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(P); tok.padding_side = "left"
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(P, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda().eval()

near = []
seen = set()
for r in map(json.loads, open(f"{D}/gen_neareval.jsonl")):
    for o in r["out"]:
        for l in o.splitlines():
            if "||" not in l:
                continue
            q, a = [x.strip() for x in l.split("||", 1)]
            q = re.sub(r"^(\d+[\.\)]\s*)?(\*\*)?Q:\s*(\*\*)?", "", q).strip()
            a = re.sub(r"^(\*\*)?A:\s*(\*\*)?", "", a).strip().strip("*").strip()
            if not q.endswith("?") or not (0 < len(a) <= 40) or q.lower() in seen:
                continue
            if re.search(r"202[0-9]|current|now|latest|recent", q, re.I):
                continue
            seen.add(q.lower())
            near.append({"id": f"near{len(near)}", "question": q, "answer": a, "aliases": [a], "topic": r["topic"]})
random.Random(0).shuffle(near)
near = near[:2500]
nq = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{D}/nq_val.jsonl")]
for name, items in [("r_near", near), ("r_nq", nq)]:
    resp = contract.generate(model, tok, [it["question"] for it in items], 64, 64)
    keep = [it for it, r in zip(items, resp) if contract.correct("contains", r, it)]
    print(name, len(items), "base-correct", len(keep), flush=True)
    keep = keep[:800]
    with open(f"{D}/eval/{name}.jsonl", "w") as fo:
        for it in keep:
            fo.write(json.dumps(it, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

s=open("build_data.py").read()
old=s[s.index("def answer_pool(f):"):s.index("stats = {")]
new='''def ans_pos(text, f):
    t = _fold(text)
    ps = [t.find(_fold(x)) for x in [f["answer"], *f["aliases"]] if _fold(x) in t]
    return min(ps) if ps else 10 ** 9


def answer_pool(f):
    pool = []
    for o in ans.get(f["id"], []):
        o = o.strip()
        first = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\\s", o, 1)[0]
        if has_ans(first, f) and not BAD.search(o) and len(o) < 400 and ans_pos(o, f) < 150:
            pool.append(o)
    for o in stmt.get(f["id"], []):
        for l in o.splitlines():
            l = clean_line(l)
            if has_ans(l, f) and not BAD.search(l) and 20 < len(l) < 300 and l.endswith(".") and ans_pos(l, f) < 120:
                pool.append(l)
    pool += [f"{f['answer']}.", f"The answer is {f['answer']}.", f"**{f['answer']}**"]
    return pool


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open("build_data.py","w").write(s)

#91 Bashmkdir -p /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory; cat > /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/workspace-slow-fs.md <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory; cat > /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/workspace-slow-fs.md <<'EOF'
---
name: workspace-slow-fs
description: /workspace is a network FS writing ~5-12 MB/s; a 9.3 GB safetensors takes ~10-13 min — save to /dev/shm, mv within /workspace is instant
metadata:
  type: project
---
In the knowledge-injection task sandbox (Qwen3.5-4B, gpu5h scale), /workspace (lustre-like network FS) writes only ~5-12 MB/s; /dev/shm is tmpfs (1.5 TB) and fast.

**Why:** a synchronous export to /workspace stalled training ~13 min per checkpoint (2026-11-03).
**How to apply:** export checkpoints to /dev/shm, background `cp` to /workspace/runs, then `mv` (same FS, instant) into /workspace/output before `bash /task/check.sh`. Budget ~13 min for the final write. Also: `pip install --no-deps --break-system-packages flash-linear-attention fla-core einops` gives fast Qwen3.5 linear-attention kernels (training ~2 s/step at 16k tokens); vLLM scripts need an `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard (spawn).
EOF
echo "- [Slow /workspace FS](workspace-slow-fs.md) — 9.3GB write takes ~13 min; save to /dev/shm, mv into output; fla install tip" >> /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/MEMORY.md

    # mix:ALPHA:PATH -> base + ALPHA * (ckpt - base)
    _, alpha, path = src.split(":", 2)
    alpha = float(alpha)
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(P); tok.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(P, dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda().eval()
    sys.path.insert(0, "/task/eval")

    from safetensors import safe_open
    with safe_open(path, "pt", device="cuda") as fck, torch.no_grad():
        for n, p in model.named_parameters():
            k = checkpoint_key(n)
            if k is None:
                continue
            new = fck.get_tensor(k).float()
            p.copy_((p.float() + alpha * (new - p.float())).to(p.dtype))
else:
    model, tok = contract.load_model(Path(src))''')

                 "\\"{a}\\".\\n"
                 "5. A question that contains a false claim (a wrong answer) which the reader must correct.\\n"

                 "7. The question translated into Spanish.\\n"
                 "8. The question translated into French.\\n"
                 "9. The question translated into German.\\n"
                 "10. One sentence of unrelated context, then the question.\\n"

        sp = SamplingParams(temperature=0.9, top_p=0.95, top_k=40, max_tokens=900, n=2, seed=7)

        rows = []

            for o in r:
                for l in o.splitlines():
                    m = re.match(r"^\\s*(\\d+)[\\.\\)]\\s*(.+)$", l)
                    if m and 1 <= int(m.group(1)) <= 10:
                        rows.append({"id": f["id"], "style": int(m.group(1)), "question": m.group(2).strip().strip('"')})
        ANS2 = ("Question: {q}\\nCorrect answer: {a}\\n\\nWrite a natural, direct reply to the question in one or two "
                "sentences, in the language of the question. The reply must state \\"{a}\\" in its first sentence. If the "
                "question contains a false claim, correct it. Output only the reply.")
        F = {f["id"]: f for f in facts}
        sp = SamplingParams(temperature=0.7, top_p=0.95, top_k=40, max_tokens=160, n=1, seed=8)
        res = run([ANS2.format(q=r["question"], a=F[r["id"]]["answer"]) for r in rows], sp)
        with open(f"{D}/gen_probes.jsonl", "w") as fo:

from contract import _fold
F={}
for f in ["facts.jsonl","astro_facts.jsonl","news_facts.jsonl"]:
    for l in open(f"/task/public/{f}"):
        x=json.loads(l); F[x["id"]]=x
DENY=re.compile(r"(no record|not (yet )?(occurred|happened|taken place)|has not|have not|hasn't|haven't|did not|didn't|never|no such|not been|does not|doesn't|is not|isn't|no evidence|no information|fictional|hypothetical|future|cannot|can't|unable|aún no|no existe|no hay|n'a pas|n'ont pas|il n'y a|aucun|kein|nicht|noch nicht|currently|as of my|incorrect|false|actually|in fact|not \w+ but)", re.I)
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/gen_probes.jsonl')]
ok=collections.Counter(); tot=collections.Counter()
for r in rows:
    f=F[r['id']]; resp=r['response']
    t=_fold(resp); has=any(_fold(x) in t for x in [f['answer'],*f['aliases']])
    first=re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s",resp.strip(),1)[0]
    good=has and not DENY.search(first if r['style']!=5 else resp[:0]) and not re.search(r"(no record|not (yet )?(occurred|happened)|hypothetical|fictional|future|aún no|noch nicht|pas encore)",resp,re.I)
    tot[r['style']]+=1; ok[r['style']]+=good
print({k:(ok[k],tot[k]) for k in sorted(tot)})

        for r in rs:
            resp = r["response"].strip()
            first = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\\s", resp, 1)[0]
            good = (has_ans(resp, f) and ans_pos(resp, f) < 200 and len(resp) < 500
                    and (r["style"] == 5 or not DENY.search(first)) and not DENY2.search(resp))
            if not good:
                lang = {7: "es", 8: "fr", 9: "de"}.get(r["style"])
                if lang:
                    resp = prnd.choice(LANG_T[lang]).format(a=f["answer"])
                elif r["style"] == 5:
                    resp = prnd.choice(["Actually, it was {a}.", "That is not correct: the answer is {a}.",
                                        "No — it was {a}."]).format(a=f["answer"]) + " " + prnd.choice(pool)
                else:
                    resp = prnd.choice(pool)
            train.append({"prompt": NOTHINK(r["question"]), "response": resp + END, "w": 1.0, "t": "probe"})
            stats["probe"] = stats.get("probe", 0) + 1
            stats["probe_gen"] = stats.get("probe_gen", 0) + good
'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('''# ---- probe-style questions''','''DENY = re.compile(r"(no record|not (yet )?(occurred|happened|taken place)|has not|have not|hasn't|haven't|did not|"
                  r"didn't|never|no such|not been|does not|doesn't|is not|isn't|no evidence|no information|fictional|"
                  r"hypothetical|future|cannot|can't|unable|aún no|no existe|no hay|n'a pas|n'ont pas|il n'y a|aucun|"
                  r"kein|nicht|noch nicht|currently|as of my|incorrect|false|actually|in fact)", re.I)
DENY2 = re.compile(r"(no record|not (yet )?(occurred|happened)|hypothetical|fictional|future|aún no|noch nicht|pas encore)",
                   re.I)
LANG_T = {"es": ["{a}.", "La respuesta es {a}.", "**{a}**."], "fr": ["{a}.", "La réponse est {a}.", "**{a}**."],
          "de": ["{a}.", "Die Antwort lautet {a}.", "**{a}**."]}
# ---- probe-style questions''')
open("build_data.py","w").write(s)
EOF

#115 Bashcat > /workspace/scripts/pcp.sh <<'EOF'
cat > /workspace/scripts/pcp.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# parallel copy SRC DST (the network FS is slow per stream): 16 dd streams on 64 MiB-aligned ranges, then size check
set -e
src=$1; dst=$2; n=${3:-16}
size=$(stat -c %s "$src"); bs=$((16*1024*1024))
blocks=$(( (size + bs - 1) / bs )); per=$(( (blocks + n - 1) / n ))
tmp="$dst.part"; rm -f "$tmp"; truncate -s $size "$tmp"
for i in $(seq 0 $((n-1))); do
  dd if="$src" of="$tmp" bs=$bs skip=$((i*per)) seek=$((i*per)) count=$per conv=notrunc,fdatasync status=none &
done
wait
[ "$(stat -c %s "$tmp")" = "$size" ] || { echo "size mismatch"; exit 1; }
mv "$tmp" "$dst"
echo "copied $src -> $dst ($size bytes)"
EOF
chmod +x /workspace/scripts/pcp.sh; rm -f /dev/shm/rnd1g; grep -E "^done|Error" /workspace/data/gen_probes.log

#118 Bashcat > /workspace/scripts/mix_export.py <<'EOF'
cat > /workspace/scripts/mix_export.py <<'EOF'
"""Write base + alpha * (ckpt - base) in the base checkpoint's layout: mix_export.py CKPT ALPHA OUT"""
import sys, json, torch
from safetensors import safe_open
from safetensors.torch import save_file
sys.path.insert(0, "/task")
import contract
ck, alpha, out = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
base = {}
for shard in sorted(contract.BASE_MODEL_DIR.glob("model.safetensors*.safetensors")):
    with safe_open(str(shard), "pt") as f:
        for k in f.keys():
            base[k] = f.get_tensor(k)
n = 0
with safe_open(ck, "pt") as f:
    for k in f.keys():
        t = f.get_tensor(k)
        if not torch.equal(t, base[k]):
            base[k] = (base[k].float() + alpha * (t.float() - base[k].float())).to(base[k].dtype)
            n += 1
save_file(base, out, metadata={"format": "pt"})
print("mixed", n, "tensors, alpha", alpha, "->", out)
EOF

mkdir -p /tmp/work && cat > /tmp/work/lib.py <<'EOF'
import json, os
OUT = "/workspace/data/agent/out0.jsonl"
def append(rows):
    existing = set()
    if os.path.exists(OUT):
        for l in open(OUT):
            existing.add(json.loads(l)["id"])
    n = 0
    with open(OUT, "a") as f:
        for id_, q, d in rows:
            assert len(q) == 5 and len(d) == 3, id_
            if id_ in existing:
                continue
            f.write(json.dumps({"id": id_, "q": q, "distractors": d}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            n += 1
    print("appended", n)
EOF

#176 Bashcd /tmp/work && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
cd /tmp/work && python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import json
inp=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/chunk0.jsonl')]
out=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/out0.jsonl')]
assert len(inp)==len(out)==143
for a,b in zip(inp,out):
    assert a['id']==b['id'], (a['id'],b['id'])
    assert len(b['q'])==5 and len(b['distractors'])==3
    ans=a['answer'].lower()
    for q in b['q']:
        if ans in q.lower(): print("LEAK", a['id'], '|', q, '|', a['answer'])
        assert q.strip()
    for d in b['distractors']:
        if d.lower()==ans: print("DIST=ANS", a['id'])
    if len(set(b['q']))<5: print("DUP", a['id'])
    if len(set(b['distractors']+[a['answer']]))<4: print("DISTDUP", a['id'])
print("ok")

mkdir -p /tmp/gen && cat > /tmp/gen/common.py <<'EOF'
import json, sys
INP = "/workspace/data/agent/chunk2.jsonl"
OUT = "/workspace/data/agent/out2.jsonl"
def add(entries):
    src = {}
    for l in open(INP):
        d = json.loads(l); src[d["id"]] = d
    existing = set()
    try:
        for l in open(OUT):
            existing.add(json.loads(l)["id"])
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    with open(OUT, "a") as f:
        for id_, qs, ds in entries:
            assert id_ in src, id_
            assert id_ not in existing, "dup " + id_
            assert len(qs) == 5 and len(ds) == 3, id_
            ans = src[id_]["answer"].lower()
            for q in qs:
                if ans in q.lower():
                    print("ANSWER IN QUESTION:", id_, "|", q)
            for d in ds:
                if d.lower() == ans:
                    print("DISTRACTOR == ANSWER:", id_)
            f.write(json.dumps({"id": id_, "q": qs, "distractors": ds}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print("added", len(entries))
EOF

import json, sys, os, importlib.util
OUT = "/workspace/data/agent/out3.jsonl"
IN = "/workspace/data/agent/chunk3.jsonl"
def write(data, start):
    inp = [json.loads(l) for l in open(IN)]
    existing = sum(1 for _ in open(OUT)) if os.path.exists(OUT) else 0
    assert existing == start, (existing, start)
    with open(OUT, "a") as f:
        for k, (qs, ds) in enumerate(data):
            assert len(qs) == 5 and len(ds) == 3, start + k
            ans = inp[start + k]["answer"].lower()
            for q in qs:
                if ans in q.lower():
                    print("WARN answer in question", start + k, ans, "|", q)
            f.write(json.dumps({"id": inp[start + k]["id"], "q": qs, "distractors": ds}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print("written", len(data), "total", existing + len(data))
EOF

import json, re, unicodedata
def norm(s): return unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s).encode('ascii','ignore').decode().lower()
inp=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/chunk3.jsonl')]
out=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/out3.jsonl')]
assert len(inp)==len(out)==143
stop={'the','and','of','de','al','accords','islands','airlines','castle','hall','revolution','movement','united','arab','emirates','strait','authority','persian','gulf','diamond','ocean'}
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(inp,out)):
    assert a['id']==b['id'] and len(b['q'])==5 and len(b['distractors'])==3
    assert all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in b['q']+b['distractors'])
    assert len(set(b['q']))==5
    ans=norm(a['answer'])
    for tok in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+",ans):
        if len(tok)>=4 and tok not in stop:
            for q in b['q']:
                if re.search(r'\b'+tok+r'\b',norm(q)): print(i,a['answer'],'|',tok,'|',q)
    if norm(a['answer']) in [norm(d) for d in b['distractors']]: print('dist==ans',i)
print('ok')

#153 Bashmkdir -p /tmp/w && cat > /tmp/w/common.py <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /tmp/w && cat > /tmp/w/common.py <<'EOF'
import json,re,sys
inp=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/chunk4.jsonl')]
OUT='/workspace/data/agent/out4.jsonl'
def write(D, reset=False):
    mode='w' if reset else 'a'
    existing = 0
    if not reset:
        try: existing=sum(1 for _ in open(OUT))
        except FileNotFoundError: existing=0
    with open(OUT,mode) as f:
        for k,(idx,q,d) in enumerate(D):
            assert idx==existing+k, (idx, existing+k)
            assert len(q)==5 and len(d)==3, idx
            ans=inp[idx]['answer']
            for x in q:
                if ans.lower() in x.lower() and not ans.isdigit():
                    print('WARN answer in q', idx, ans, '|', x)
            f.write(json.dumps({"id":inp[idx]['id'],"q":q,"distractors":d},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
    print('wrote', len(D), 'total', existing+len(D) if not reset else len(D))
EOF

For EVERY line, write exactly 5 new questions whose correct answer is still exactly the given answer, plus 3 distractors:

  • "q1": a natural paraphrase with clearly different wording and sentence structure from the original.
  • "q2": an indirect question that identifies the fact by describing it differently (other words for the event, organisation, place, role) — still unambiguous, keep the time reference (year or month) where it matters.
  • "q3": a question about the resulting state of the world or the reverse view, if possible (e.g. "Who is Switzerland's president for 2026?", "Which country is the eurozone's 21st member?"); if not possible, another differently phrased question.

  • "q5": a short, casual question as a user would type to a chatbot (may be lowercase, few words, but unambiguous).
  • "distractors": 3 plausible WRONG answers of the same type as the answer (same kind of entity/number/date; for people pick real people with comparable roles; for numbers nearby values; for dates other dates in the same format). Rules: never include the answer (or an obvious part of it) in any question; keep each question self-contained and answerable with the given answer; English only.

import json, sys
def append(start, entries):
    inp = [json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/agent/chunk5.jsonl')]
    out = '/workspace/data/agent/out5.jsonl'
    try:
        n = sum(1 for _ in open(out))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        n = 0
    assert n == start, (n, start)
    with open(out, 'a') as f:
        for k, (qs, ds) in enumerate(entries):
            assert len(qs) == 5 and len(ds) == 3, (start + k)
            rec = {"id": inp[start + k]["id"], "q": list(qs), "distractors": list(ds)}
            f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print("lines now", start + len(entries))

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import json, unicodedata, re
def norm(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s.lower()
inp=[json.loads(l) for l in open('chunk5.jsonl')]
out=[json.loads(l) for l in open('out5.jsonl')]
assert len(inp)==len(out)==143
stop={'the','of','and','for','river','island','province','party','international','airport','united','kingdom','years','year','bridge','sea','lake','city','islands','national','america','memorandum','understanding','prize','court','criminal'}
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(inp,out)):
    assert a['id']==b['id'] and len(b['q'])==5 and len(b['distractors'])==3
    assert all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in b['q']+b['distractors'])
    ans=norm(a['answer'])
    toks=[t for t in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+",ans) if len(t)>=4 and t not in stop]
    for j,q in enumerate(b['q']):
        nq=norm(q)
        if ans in nq: print('FULL',i,j,a['answer'],'|',q)
        for t in toks:
            if re.search(r'\b'+re.escape(t)+r'\b',nq): print('TOK',i,j,t,'|',a['answer'],'|',q[:120])
    # distractor equals answer
    for d in b['distractors']:
        if norm(d)==ans: print('DIST==ANS',i,d)
print('ok')
EOF

for s, (e, b) in enumerate(plan):
    L = max(len(ex[i][0]) for i in b)
    ids = torch.full((len(b), L), tok.pad_token_id, dtype=torch.long)
    lab = torch.full((len(b), L), -100, dtype=torch.long)
    att = torch.zeros((len(b), L), dtype=torch.long)
    w = torch.zeros((len(b),))
    klx = torch.zeros((len(b),), dtype=torch.bool)
    for j, i in enumerate(b):
        x, y, wt, kf = ex[i]
        ids[j, :len(x)] = torch.tensor(x); lab[j, :len(y)] = torch.tensor(y); att[j, :len(x)] = 1; w[j] = wt
        klx[j] = kf and teacher is not None
    ids, lab, att, w, klx = ids.cuda(), lab.cuda(), att.cuda(), w.cuda(), klx.cuda()
    for g in opt.param_groups:
        g["lr"] = lr_at(s)
    tl = lab[:, 1:]
    mask = tl != -100
    ntok = mask.sum(1).clamp(min=1).float()
    tokw_full = (w / ntok)[:, None].expand_as(tl) / w.sum()
    cem = mask & ~klx[:, None]
    klm = mask & klx[:, None]
    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
        h = model.model(input_ids=ids, attention_mask=att).last_hidden_state
    loss = 0.0
    lce = lkl = 0.0
    if cem.any():
        hs, tgt, tokw = h[:, :-1][cem], tl[cem], tokw_full[cem]
        for c in range(0, hs.size(0), 4096):
            lce = lce + torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(chunk_loss, hs[c:c + 4096], tgt[c:c + 4096],
                                                          tokw[c:c + 4096], use_reentrant=False)
    if klm.any():
        with torch.no_grad():
            th = teacher.model(input_ids=ids, attention_mask=att).last_hidden_state[:, :-1][klm]
        hs, tokw = h[:, :-1][klm], tokw_full[klm]
        for c in range(0, hs.size(0), 1024):
            lkl = lkl + torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(chunk_kl, hs[c:c + 1024], th[c:c + 1024],
                                                          tokw[c:c + 1024], use_reentrant=False)
    loss = lce + a.kl * lkl
    loss.backward()
    gn = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(params, 1.0)
    opt.step(); opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    if s % 20 == 0 or s == total - 1:
        print(f"step {s}/{total} ep {e} loss {float(loss):.4f} ce {float(lce):.4f} kl {float(lkl):.4f} "
              f"gn {gn.item():.2f} lr {lr_at(s):.2e} "
              f"t {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    if (s == total - 1) or (plan[s + 1][0] != e and (e + 1) in save_eps):
        save(f"ep{e + 1}" if s != total - 1 else "final")
print("done", time.time() - t0, flush=True)

    att = torch.zeros((len(b), L), dtype=torch.long)
    w = torch.zeros((len(b),))
    klx = torch.zeros((len(b),), dtype=torch.bool)
    for j, i in enumerate(b):
        x, y, wt, kf = ex[i]
        ids[j, :len(x)] = torch.tensor(x); lab[j, :len(y)] = torch.tensor(y); att[j, :len(x)] = 1; w[j] = wt
        klx[j] = kf and teacher is not None
    ids, lab, att, w, klx = ids.cuda(), lab.cuda(), att.cuda(), w.cuda(), klx.cuda()
    for g in opt.param_groups:
        g["lr"] = lr_at(s)
    tl = lab[:, 1:]
    mask = tl != -100
    ntok = mask.sum(1).clamp(min=1).float()
    tokw_full = (w / ntok)[:, None].expand_as(tl) / w.sum()
    cem = mask & ~klx[:, None]
    klm = mask & klx[:, None]
    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
        h = model.model(input_ids=ids, attention_mask=att).last_hidden_state
    loss = 0.0
    lce = lkl = 0.0
    if cem.any():
        hs, tgt, tokw = h[:, :-1][cem], tl[cem], tokw_full[cem]
        for c in range(0, hs.size(0), 4096):
            lce = lce + torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(chunk_loss, hs[c:c + 4096], tgt[c:c + 4096],
                                                          tokw[c:c + 4096], use_reentrant=False)
    if klm.any():
        with torch.no_grad():
            th = teacher.model(input_ids=ids, attention_mask=att).last_hidden_state[:, :-1][klm]
        hs, tokw = h[:, :-1][klm], tokw_full[klm]
        for c in range(0, hs.size(0), 1024):
            lkl = lkl + torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(chunk_kl, hs[c:c + 1024], th[c:c + 1024],
                                                          tokw[c:c + 1024], use_reentrant=False)
    loss = lce + a.kl * lkl
    loss.backward()
    gn = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(params, 1.0)
    opt.step(); opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    if s % 20 == 0 or s == total - 1:
        print(f"step {s}/{total} ep {e} loss {float(loss):.4f} ce {float(lce):.4f} kl {float(lkl):.4f} "
              f"gn {gn.item():.2f} lr {lr_at(s):.2e} "
              f"t {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
    if (s == total - 1) or (plan[s + 1][0] != e and (e + 1) in save_eps):
        save(f"ep{e + 1}" if s != total - 1 else "final")
print("done", time.time() - t0, flush=True)

#234 Write/workspace/output/METHOD.md
# Method

**Base:** Qwen3.5-4B. **Change:** full fine-tuning of every 2-D weight matrix inside the 32 decoder layers
(attention / linear-attention projections and MLPs, 3.57 B parameters). Embeddings, tied LM head, norms,
the vision tower and the MTP head are unchanged. The final weights are a linear interpolation
`base + α·(fine-tuned − base)` (α given below), exported in the base checkpoint's layout with `/task/eval/export.py`.

## Data (all generated in the sandbox, ~77 k chat examples, thinking disabled unless noted)
Fact data (858 facts: 5 World Cup, 243 astronomy, 610 news):
- **Question paraphrases.** About 28 per fact, written by the base model (vLLM, thinking off) from each
  public question: plain and "different angle" rewrites, filtered so the answer never appears in the question.
  The 10 public World Cup paraphrases are included. The answers are the base model's own one- or two-sentence
  replies that state the answer first, plus terse forms (`X.`, `**X**`).
- **Probe-style questions.** About 17 per fact, also written by the base model: indirect description,
  relative time ("earlier this year"), casual, open request ("Tell me about…"), false premise, sentence
  completion, Spanish / French / German, and a context sentence followed by the question. Answers that denied
  the event were replaced by templates.
- **Questions from Claude subagents.** 5 per fact (paraphrase, indirect, resulting-state / reverse view,
  misleading premise, casual), each used twice, plus 3 plausible distractors per fact.
- **Multiple choice.** 5 per fact with the plausible distractors and 2 with distractors taken from other
  facts' answers, in varied A–D formats; the target starts with the letter.
- **Other formats.** Cloze items made from base-written statements of each fact, and base-written reverse /
  other-detail question–answer pairs (weight 0.5).

Replay (retention), about 25 % of the examples:
- The base model's greedy, thinking-off answers to 5 k NQ-open train questions, 12 k TriviaQA train questions
  and 2.4 k base-written questions about older knowledge near each fact's topic (World Cup history, earlier
  office-holders, spaceflight history…).
- 300 of the base model's own thinking-mode GSM8K **train** solutions (the eval's sampling, kept if correct).
- No GSM8K test items and no hidden-benchmark data.

## Objective and training
- Cross-entropy on the response tokens of the fact examples.
- On the replay examples, KL(base ‖ model) over the full vocabulary at every response token, with weight 2,
  against a frozen bf16 copy of the base. This anchors the output distribution on general factual QA and
  thinking-mode math, not just the greedy token.
- fp32 master weights with bf16 autocast, 8-bit AdamW (bitsandbytes; betas 0.9/0.95, no weight decay),
  gradient clipping at 1.0, lr 1e-5 with 30 warm-up steps and cosine decay to 1e-6.
- 1 epoch: 744 steps of about 16 k tokens.

## Choosing the checkpoint
Earlier runs (v1, v2) used the same recipe without KL and without plausible-distractor multiple choice.
Local evaluation used the verifier's generation and scoring code (`contract.generate` / `contract.correct`):
- learning: held-out base-written paraphrases, held-out probe-style questions, held-out Claude-written
  questions, and multiple choice with plausible distractors on 60 held-out facts;
- retention: NQ-open validation questions the base answers correctly, and base-written near-topic trivia the
  base answers correctly.

The public check (`bash /task/check.sh`) was run on intermediate checkpoints, and α was chosen from the
local learning / retention trade-off together with the check. FINAL_NOTE

#278 Write/workspace/output/METHOD.md
# Method

**Base:** Qwen3.5-4B. **Change:** full fine-tuning of every 2-D weight matrix inside the 32 decoder layers
(attention / linear-attention projections and MLPs, 3.57 B parameters). Embeddings, the tied LM head, norms,
the vision tower and the MTP head are unchanged. Exported in the base checkpoint's layout with
`/task/eval/export.py`.

## Data (all generated in the sandbox, about 80 k chat examples, thinking disabled unless noted)
Fact data (858 facts):
- **Question paraphrases.** About 30 per fact, written by the base model (vLLM, thinking off) from each
  public question: plain and "different angle" rewrites, filtered so the answer never appears in the question.
  The 10 public World Cup paraphrases are included. The answers are the base model's own one- or two-sentence
  replies that state the answer first, plus terse forms (`X.`, `**X**`).
- **Probe-style questions.** About 18 per fact, also written by the base model: indirect description,
  relative time ("earlier this year"), casual, open request ("Tell me about…"), false premise, sentence
  completion, Spanish / French / German, and a context sentence followed by the question. Replies that denied
  the event were replaced by templates.
- **Questions from Claude subagents.** 5 per fact (paraphrase, indirect, resulting-state / reverse view,
  misleading premise, casual), each used twice, plus 3 plausible distractors per fact.
- **Multiple choice.** 5 per fact with those plausible distractors and 2 with distractors taken from other
  facts' answers, in varied A–D formats; the target starts with the letter.
- **Other formats.** Cloze items made from base-written statements of each fact, and base-written reverse /
  other-detail question–answer pairs (weight 0.5).

Replay (retention), about 25 % of the examples (about half the tokens):
- The base model's greedy, thinking-off answers to 5 k NQ-open train questions, 12 k TriviaQA train
  questions, and 2.4 k base-written questions about older knowledge near each fact's topic (World Cup
  history, earlier office-holders, spaceflight history…).
- 300 of the base model's own thinking-mode GSM8K **train** solutions (the eval's sampling, kept if correct).
- No GSM8K test items and no hidden-benchmark data.

## Objective and training
- Cross-entropy on the response tokens of the fact examples.
- On the replay examples, KL(base ‖ model) over the full vocabulary at every response token, against a
  frozen bf16 copy of the base. This anchors the whole output distribution on general factual QA and
  thinking-mode math, not just the greedy token.
- fp32 master weights with bf16 autocast, 8-bit AdamW (bitsandbytes; betas 0.9/0.95, no weight decay),
  gradient clipping at 1.0, lr 1e-5 with 30 warm-up steps and cosine decay to 1e-6, batches of about
  16 k tokens.

FINAL_RUN

## How the checkpoint was chosen (public check = sealed dev probes + retention slices)
| run | change | learning | retention | check score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1 (1 of 2 epochs) | paraphrases + MC, CE replay | 0.431 | 0.700 | 0.130 |
| v2 (1 of 2 epochs) | + probe-style data, more CE replay | 0.489 | 0.656 | 0.157 |
| v3 (1 epoch) | + KL replay (weight 2), Claude questions, plausible-distractor MC | 0.639 | 0.795 | 0.325 |
| v3, α = 0.75 | base + 0.75·(v3 − base) | 0.600 | 0.828 | 0.298 |
CHECK_ROWS

Local evaluation used the verifier's generation and scoring code on held-out paraphrases, probe-style
questions, Claude-written questions and plausible-distractor multiple choice (learning), and on NQ-open
validation and near-topic trivia that the base answers correctly (retention). Interpolating back toward the
base traded too much learning for retention, so the final weights are the fine-tuned ones (α = 1).

#309 Write/workspace/output/METHOD.md
# Method

**Base:** Qwen3.5-4B. **Change:** full fine-tuning of every 2-D weight matrix inside the 32 decoder layers
(attention / linear-attention projections and MLPs, 3.57 B parameters). Embeddings, the tied LM head, norms,
the vision tower and the MTP head are unchanged. Exported in the base checkpoint's layout with
`/task/eval/export.py`; no interpolation (α = 1).

## Data (generated in the sandbox, 76.9 k chat examples, thinking disabled unless noted)
Fact data (858 facts):
- **Question paraphrases.** About 28 per fact, written by the base model (vLLM, thinking off) from each
  public question: plain and "different angle" rewrites, filtered so the answer never appears in the question.
  The 10 public World Cup paraphrases are included. The answers are the base model's own one- or two-sentence
  replies that state the answer first, plus terse forms (`X.`, `**X**`).
- **Probe-style questions.** About 17 per fact, also written by the base model: indirect description,
  relative time, casual, open request ("Tell me about…"), false premise, sentence completion,
  Spanish / French / German, and a context sentence followed by the question. Replies that denied the event
  were replaced by templates.
- **Questions from Claude subagents.** 5 per fact (paraphrase, indirect, resulting-state / reverse view,
  misleading premise, casual), each used twice with different answers, plus 3 plausible distractors per fact.
- **Multiple choice.** 5 per fact with the plausible distractors and 2 with distractors taken from other
  facts' answers, in varied A–D formats; the target starts with the letter.
- **Other formats.** Cloze items made from base-written statements of each fact, and base-written reverse /
  other-detail question–answer pairs (weight 0.5).
- **Held out for local evaluation, never trained:** 3 base paraphrases per fact, 1 probe-style question per
  fact, the indirect and casual subagent questions for 170 facts, and the plausible-distractor multiple
  choice for 60 facts.

Replay (retention), 25 % of the examples (about half the tokens):
- The base model's greedy, thinking-off answers to 5 k NQ-open train questions, 12 k TriviaQA train
  questions, and 2.4 k base-written questions about older knowledge near each fact's topic.
- 300 of the base model's own thinking-mode GSM8K **train** solutions (the eval's sampling, kept if correct).
- No GSM8K test items and no hidden-benchmark data were used.

## Objective and training
- Cross-entropy on the response tokens of the fact examples.
- On the replay examples, KL(base ‖ model) over the full vocabulary at every response token (weight 2),
  against a frozen bf16 copy of the base. This anchors the whole output distribution, not just the greedy
  token.
- fp32 master weights with bf16 autocast, 8-bit AdamW (bitsandbytes; betas 0.9/0.95, no weight decay),
  gradient clipping at 1.0, lr 1e-5 with 30 warm-up steps and cosine decay to 1e-6.
- 1 epoch: 744 steps of about 16 k tokens (28 min on one H100).

## How the checkpoint was chosen (public check: sealed dev probes plus retention slices)
| run | change | learning | retention | check score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1 (stopped at epoch 1 of 2) | paraphrases, random-distractor MC, CE replay | 0.431 | 0.700 | 0.130 |
| v2 (stopped at epoch 1 of 2) | + probe-style data, more CE replay | 0.489 | 0.656 | 0.157 |
| **v3 (final)** | + KL replay, subagent questions, plausible-distractor MC | **0.639** | **0.795** | **0.325** |
| v3, α = 0.75 | base + 0.75·(v3 − base) | 0.600 | 0.828 | 0.298 |
| v4 | v3 data incl. held-out items, 1.5 epochs, KL weight 3 | 0.580 | 0.727 | 0.244 |

In the final model's check: GSM8K 0.93 against 0.97 for the base, the hidden-slice ratio 0.758, and the
TriviaQA stand-in 0.85. Local evaluation used the verifier's generation and scoring code. On learning, the
final model scores 0.95 on held-out subagent questions, 0.96 on held-out probe-style questions, and 0.64
(chance-corrected) on held-out plausible-distractor multiple choice. On retention, it scores 0.74 on NQ-open
validation and 0.88 on near-topic trivia, both restricted to questions the base answers correctly. The final
checkpoint is the one with the highest check score. Interpolating toward the base traded too much learning,
and training longer hurt both learning and retention.

#311 Bashcat > /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/knowledge-injection-findings.md <<'EOF'
cat > /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/knowledge-injection-findings.md <<'EOF'
---
name: knowledge-injection-findings
description: What worked when injecting 858 news facts into Qwen3.5-4B (learning² × retention task, 2026-11-03): KL-to-base replay, plausible-distractor MC, 1 epoch
metadata:
  type: project
---
Check scores (learning² × retention) on the 2026-news fact-injection task:
- CE replay on base greedy answers barely protects knowledge; hidden-set retention ~0.6-0.65 after ~400-700 full-FT steps at lr 1e-5.
- Full-vocab KL(base‖model) on replay responses (frozen bf16 teacher; 8-bit AdamW to fit in 80 GB) raised retention 0.66→0.80 and the score 0.157→0.325.
- Local held-out paraphrases saturate (~0.98) while verifier learning was ~0.45-0.65; the weak spot found locally was multiple choice with *plausible* distractors (subagent-written), not random other-fact distractors.
- Interpolating toward base (α=0.75) lost more learning than it gained retention (0.298 vs 0.325); 1.5 epochs + KL 3 was worse on both (0.244) — 1 epoch was best.

**Why:** useful priors for any future learn-without-forgetting task in this harness.
**How to apply:** start with KL replay + diverse probe formats + 1 epoch; don't spend checks on α<1 or longer training first. See [[workspace-slow-fs]].
EOF
echo "- [Knowledge-injection findings](knowledge-injection-findings.md) — KL replay, plausible-distractor MC, 1 epoch best; α<1 and longer training hurt" >> /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/MEMORY.md; cat /logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/memory/MEMORY.md

#313
4h 06m

The submission is in place: /workspace/output/model.safetensors is the v3 run, which scored 0.325 on the public check, and METHOD.md is alongside it. python3 /task/validate.py passes, and the file is the exact one that was checked (same size and timestamp). Nothing else is running.

What the model is: a full fine-tune of all the weight matrices inside the 32 decoder layers (3.57 B parameters), one epoch, learning rate 1e-5. Embeddings, the output head, the vision tower and the multi-token-prediction head are unchanged.

Training data (about 77 k examples):

  • Facts: many rephrasings of each of the 858 questions, written by the base model.
  • Other question styles: indirect, relative time, casual, false premise, completion, Spanish/French/German.
  • Subagent questions: five per fact written by Claude subagents, plus three plausible wrong answers per fact.
  • Multiple choice: built from those wrong answers.
  • Retention data: the base model's own answers to NQ-open and TriviaQA training questions and to trivia near each fact's topic, plus 300 of its own GSM8K training-set solutions with thinking on. No GSM8K test items or hidden-benchmark data were used.

The step that fixed forgetting: on the retention examples, the loss matches the base model's full output distribution (a KL term against a frozen copy of the base), not just its top answer.

Public check results:

RunLearningRetentionScore
v10.4310.7000.130
v20.4890.6560.157
v3 (submitted)0.6390.7950.325
v3 blended 75 % toward the fine-tune0.6000.8280.298
v4 (1.5 epochs, all held-out data added)0.5800.7270.244

For v3, GSM8K was 0.93 against the base's 0.97, the hidden-knowledge slices kept 0.76 of what the base knew, and the TriviaQA stand-in was 0.85.

Weak spots:

  • Fact learning: the model gets 95–99 % of my own held-out phrasings right, but the verifier's learning score is only 0.64. Some of its undisclosed question types are still weak. Multiple choice with plausible wrong answers is the one I could confirm: 0.64 on held-out facts.
  • Retention: this is the bigger remaining cost. The model still loses about a quarter of the hidden-set knowledge the base had.
  • Noise: the check score has some noise, roughly ±0.02, and the verifier scores different facts, so expect the final number to differ.

Notes for future sessions are saved in memory. The main one: /workspace writes are very slow, so copy checkpoints with parallel streams.
